findings.title: Bind reviewed block content before accepting seeder replay or an editor no-op
findings.description: The loader checks that hashes are syntactically valid and that field blocks have the expected shape, but does not bind the reviewed block values to those hashes. curate_seed checks only the original seeder input hash, then applies the blocks without a reviewed output check. A stale edit to a ledger block therefore changes valid regenerated scientific content while every existing review pin remains unchanged. On the same edited ledger, curate_record_text accepts the previously committed output as an unchanged success before examining the block values. This creates inconsistent results across the two maintained writer routes.

steps: Load the actual 24-record ledger and change only HELIX_TURN_HELIX blocks.definition in a temporary ledger copy; preserve all input/output/seeder pins.
Point the real loader to that temporary file and run load_curations(); it succeeds.
Call actual seed_secondary_structure.emit() for HTH; it emits the changed definition.
Write the emitted record through write_validated_record() to a temporary path; strict validation returns no errors.
Call curate_record_text() for the committed original output and same stale ledger; it returns an unchanged success.

observed.seeded_definition: Changed scientific definition without a new reviewed output hash.

findings.impact: An accidental or incomplete follow-up ledger edit can silently produce scientific seed output not covered by the stored reviewed output pin, and the normal editor dry-run can fail to identify the drift. The currently committed 24 records do match their output pins; this finding concerns enforcement of the reviewed-input contract, not a demonstrated mismatch in those committed records.
findings.proposed_fix: Validate a digest binding the reviewed blocks, or equivalent per-owner reviewed output pins, before either route accepts the entry; account for legitimate differences between source emission and corpus bytes. Do not treat the corpus output hash alone as a seed-output hash when unrelated retained fields differ.
acceptance_checks: A temporary real ledger whose definition, evidence or causal_graphs block changes without matching reviewed integrity metadata must fail loader/editor/seeder paths before any record write.
Cover the editor path where the existing record already matches output_sha256; it must still detect stale ledger block content.
Exercise all three actual seeder integrations; retain rejection of original source drift.
Keep all 24 committed record outputs reproducible from pinned input snapshots, current replay idempotent, and all 25 source/owner emissions semantically consistent with committed records.
